column1: # Kernel-load trace of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at 0364432dab: qwen3.8-flash-next-gptq3.mq4
# (gfx1151 Strix Halo, gfx1201 R9700 with host-mapped experts) and the shipped
# qwen3.8-flash-next.mq4 (gfx1151, gfx1201). Each run: load, greedy AR on ~20, ~100,
# ~300, ~450, ~1.4K and ~3K-token prompts, greedy native MTP on ~20, ~1.4K and ~3K.
# Empty exe-relative cold dir; each row is a <module>.index.json the runtime
# wrote back. Columns: arch, module, symbols the run resolved.
# gfx1201 inventory also covers the default fused FN dense scan's loaded
# modules; pipe128 Q8 remains required for short tails and decode.
# Cold-kernel-cache runs with the kernel pack installed exe-relative:
# qwen3.8-flash-next-gptq3.mq4, default route, Ciru 128K/8K/32K prefill, greedy AR,
# greedy and sampled native MTP, serve battery. gfx1151 (Strix Halo, 0614d9e2a8 pack):
# modules the runtime JIT-compiled into the empty kernel cache. gfx1201 (R9700 card B,
# fixed pack): modules the run loaded from the pack that the 9e24ed333b pack lacks
# (symbols from their default callsites), plus qwen4_silu_mul, which that run still
# JIT-compiled before it was added for gfx1201.
# Penalized requests (perf/mtp-penalties-free): greedy AR and sampled native MTP
# with repeat/presence/frequency penalties load the GPU penalty prepass module.
# gfx1100: the HIP rows of route_plans/qwen3.8-flash-next.gfx1100.tsv (module-load route walk, scripts/route_plan_walk.py --profile xtx-fn-bounded),
# union of the ar and native_mtp routes; embedded images are not cold-cache modules.
